publicExploration.procedure: When no pending physical probe: if FrontBlocked rotate right; else two of every three eligible choices do a real forward probe then (only if actually moved) execute left,left,forward,left,left,right to reenter departed cell with observed consequences; third eligible choice commits a forward step and rotates right. If probe forward did not move, abandon return plan and rotate right. Action queue stores no future source state; after every real step verify only public six fields. Never read hidden wall map, goal path, source reward or unused actions for choosing prefix.

categoryRules.actual_physical_reentry: actual current physical (x,y) has been departed earlier and this latest selected action physically reentered it; never heading-only turn
categoryRules.failed_actual_forward: last two actual chosen forward actions did not change observed x/y
categoryRules.novel_physical_edge: current observed physical x/y never previously used as a qualified anchor

trueSourceInterventions.commonAfterActionController: original public full-grid BFS; more informed than all compared learner inputs

models.currentOnly: independently fully trained existing 21-dimensional public current-state ridge
models.history12: independently FIT trained current plus last 12 witnessed selected public action/physical motion events and source-private-free aggregate counts
models.newGraph: current public feature and witnessed persistent per-(x,y,heading) forward attempted/successful/failed edge memory, public cell revisit frequency, unique physical cells, and signed count of real completed returns; source maps only from actual selected actions
models.graphNonparametric: fully FIT trained graph-local empirical return table with per-action average source return shrinkage 16
